_help: Edit this file to maintain the Kit Explorer. kits[].requires = boxes the shop says are needed first (shown as info). experiments[].kits = ALL boxes needed for that experiment. experiments[].doc = Docusaurus doc id (path under docs/ without extension, number prefixes like '01_' removed, or the frontmatter 'id') OR a full https:// URL, OR null if not documented yet. Unknown doc ids are flagged as broken on the page.

kits.name: CoreBox
kits.description: Entry-level box for geometrical optics: lenses, mirrors, telescope and a smartphone microscope. Foundation for all microscopy add-ons.
contents: 2x lens f = 50 mm, 1x lens f = 100 mm, 1x lens f = -50 mm

kits.name: Electronics Add-On
kits.description: Motorizes the microscope: ESP32 controller, stepper Z-stage and a programmable LED matrix.
contents: USB cables, game controller, 12 V power supply

kits.name: Infinity Add-On
kits.description: Infinity-corrected optics with an industrial camera for digital and computational microscopy.

kits.name: Fluorescence Add-On (LED, 488 nm)
kits.description: Entry into fluorescence microscopy with a high-power blue LED and a GFP filter set.
contents: High-power 480 nm LED with aspheric lens

kits.name: Fluorescence Add-On (Laser, 488 nm)
kits.description: Laser-based fluorescence microscopy with a fiber-coupled 488 nm laser.

kits.name: Raspberry Pi with ImSwitch
kits.description: Raspberry Pi 5 pre-installed with ImSwitch to control cameras, stages and lasers.

kits.name: Light-Sheet Add-On
kits.description: Turns the laser fluorescence setup into a light-sheet microscope for gentle 3D imaging.
contents: Solid base plate + 8x puzzle base plates

kits.name: QBox (Quantum Box)
kits.description: Standalone laser box for interferometry, polarization and quantum optics up to ODMR with NV diamonds.
contents: Magnet, XYZ stage with NV-diamond board
10x puzzle base plates + solid base plate

kits.name: Interferometer Box
kits.description: Standalone box for interference and polarization experiments (QBox without the ODMR parts).
contents: 10x puzzle base plates + solid base plate

kits.name: HoloBox
kits.description: Standalone box with laser, interferometer optics and a Raspberry Pi camera for digital holography.
contents: Pinhole, fiber holder, lens f = 44.5 mm

experiments.name: Galilean & Kepler telescope
experiments.description: Build both classic telescope types and find out why one image is upside-down.

experiments.name: Smartphone microscope

experiments.name: Laser fluorescence microscope

experiments.name: Light-sheet microscope
experiments.description: Illuminate only a thin plane of the sample and scan it in 3D.
